title: Rasuwa fell as Mustang surged
detail: Bhadra-only imports through Rasuwa fell about -60.6%, while Mustang rose from Rs 0.59B to Rs 7.74B.

title: Processed soybean oil drives nearly half of exports
detail: Soya-bean oil (excl. crude) and fractions contributed Rs 36.05B, about 47.1% of cumulative exports through Bhadra.

title: Bhadra became more import-heavy
detail: Bhadra-only imports rose 14.2% from Shrawan while exports changed -2.1%, widening the monthly deficit to Rs 176.19B.

title: India remains Nepal’s dominant trade partner
detail: India accounts for roughly 55% of cumulative imports and 85% of cumulative exports through Bhadra.
